Hi Jonas,

I agree this is most likely due to the column names. Can you check that your columns match with the ones listed below? I am working on adding an example dataset for Spectronaut for this converter, but for now you can cross reference your data with example in base MSstats (example code to get this also below).

Devon

```
library(MSstats)
spectronaut_raw = system.file("tinytest/raw_data/Spectronaut/spectronaut_input.csv",
                              package = "MSstatsConvert")
spectronaut_raw = data.table::fread(spectronaut_raw)
```
